acceptance_criteria.criterion: For each of `Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk`, `xunit`, `xunit.runner.visualstudio`, `FluentAssertions`: the `Version` attribute is byte-identical in all three test csprojs.
All three test csprojs declare the same `TreatWarningsAsErrors` value (or all three omit it, deferring to `Directory.Build.props`).
The `Serilog` direct `<PackageReference>` version in `Infrastructure.Tests` matches the Serilog version transitively brought in by `Serilog.Extensions.Hosting` after WP-002.
`dotnet restore` and `dotnet build` of the test projects complete with zero warnings and zero errors.

summary: Unified test-project configuration and packages across all three test csprojs. Added VideoIndexer.Infrastructure.Tests to VideoIndexer.sln (it was missing). Fixed TreatWarningsAsErrors alignment, bumped stale package versions in Infrastructure.Tests, added FluentAssertions, bumped Serilog direct reference to 4.3.0 (matching transitive version from Serilog.Extensions.Hosting 10.0.0), and resolved a pre-existing CS8767/CS8766 nullability warning in SpdbConfigRepositoryTests.cs by applying [AllowNull] to the ConnectionString property. Full solution build: 0 warnings, 0 errors.

comments.note: VideoIndexer.Infrastructure.Tests was not included in VideoIndexer.sln prior to this WP. It was silently excluded from all solution-level builds. Added as part of AC5 fix. Root cause likely an oversight when the project was created.

NonDisposingConnectionWrapper in SpdbConfigRepositoryTests.cs had a pre-existing CS8767 nullability mismatch on ConnectionString. Fixed with [AllowNull] to correctly match IDbConnection's [AllowNull] attribute contract. Consider extracting this helper to a shared test utilities class if used across multiple test files.
VideoIndexer.Infrastructure.Tests.csproj lacks a <RootNamespace> declaration, unlike the other two test projects. Functionally harmless but inconsistent.

summary: All 5 acceptance criteria verified against the three modified test csproj files and solution. Package versions (Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk 17.12.0, xunit 2.9.3, xunit.runner.visualstudio 2.8.2, FluentAssertions 6.12.2) are byte-identical across all three test csprojs (AC1). IsTestProject=true confirmed in Infrastructure.Tests (AC2). All three projects set TreatWarningsAsErrors=false consistently (AC3). Serilog 4.3.0 direct reference verified against transitive resolution via dotnet list package --include-transitive (AC4). dotnet restore: clean. dotnet build: 0 warnings, 0 errors (AC5). Test run: 151 passed, 0 failed, 2 skipped (live integration tests — expected/intentional). VideoIndexer.Infrastructure.Tests confirmed present in VideoIndexer.sln. [AllowNull] fix on NonDisposingConnectionWrapper.ConnectionString correctly resolves the IDbConnection nullability contract.

comments.note: The 2 skipped tests (FfmpegProvisionerLiveTests and TarXzArchiveExtractorTests) are intentional live integration tests that require external resources. No action needed.
No observations beyond above — code is clean and consistent. All package versions aligned, IsTestProject set, TreatWarningsAsErrors uniform, Serilog version matched, solution file updated correctly.

If this wrapper pattern is needed in other test files in the future, it should be extracted to a shared test utilities class.
